title: find stub functions via the AST
spec: Module stub_detector. find_stubs(source: str) -> list[str]: the names, in source order, of every function or method (including async) whose body, ignoring a leading docstring, consists only of pass, ..., raise NotImplementedError (with or without parentheses), or a bare return / return None. A function whose body is only a docstring is a stub. Raise SyntaxError for invalid source.
